name: Logitech USB Receiver C52E (keyboard)
notes: 59-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface of a real Logitech USB Receiver C52E, from a libinput record of the device on Linux: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libinput/libinput/uploads/472af6265a96d17559d0532dc82e4aa5/libinput_record. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
